events.observation:
EXCHANGE. Three settlers, eight rounds. You start with one coin and two spare boards. [work: 1] earns a coin. [build: workshop] costs 3; your first workshop earns a 4-coin grant once per game. You must pay before receiving a grant. [dismantle: workshop] returns 2 coins. [buy: crate] costs 2 coins for one crate; [split: crate] turns a crate into three boards; [sell: boards] sells all boards for one coin each. [reserve: boards] moves all boards into a shipping manifest, making them unavailable for sale. [collect: trade] cancels that shipment and returns its boards once. A market offer buys one board for 4 coins; it expires after round 2. Use [accept: offer] to sell a board. Rivals work each round. Final wealth is coins plus two per workshop; boards/crates have no settlement value.
Round 1/8. Scores: [1.0, 1.0, 1.0].
Last resolution: The game begins.
